messages.content: 有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？

function.name: movies_search
function.description: Search movies based on a set of specified criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: The release year of the movie.

message.content: 截至目前（2023 年底），全球票房最高的电影是《阿凡达》（Avatar，2009）。该片在全球累计票房约为 28 亿美元（约 280 亿人民币），保持着最高票房纪录。第二名是《复仇者联盟：终局之战》（Avengers: Endgame，2019），票房约 27 亿美元。需要注意的是，这些数字不考虑通货膨胀或地区差异；若按通胀调整后，排名可能会有所变化。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" which means "What is the highest-grossing movie of all time?" They want the highest grossing film worldwide. That would be "Avatar" (2009) or "Avengers: Endgame"? As of 2023, "Avatar" remains the highest worldwide grossing film at about $2.92 billion. But we need to confirm with the function? The function is movies_search, but it only searches movies based on title, year, and optional genre. It doesn't provide ranking or box office data. So we cannot use the function to answer this question. We can answer directly: "截至目前（2023年），全球票房最高的电影是《阿凡達》（Avatar，2009）". Or mention that "Avengers: Endgame" was second. Provide context. Also note that inflation adjustments might change ranking. Provide answer in Chinese.
